subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Analisar as formas de uso das mídias e tecnologias pelas diferentes denominações religiosas.

components.description_pt: Identificar tipos de mídia e tecnologia usados por diferentes denominações religiosas
components.description_en: Identify types of media and technology used by different religious denominations

components.description_pt: Analisar propósitos para os quais grupos religiosos empregam mídia digital e tradicional
components.description_en: Analyze the purposes for which religious groups employ digital and traditional media
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the effectiveness of digital media choices in supporting a presentation's purpose

components.description_pt: Comparar estratégias que diferentes denominações religiosas usam para comunicar via tecnologia
components.description_en: Compare strategies different religious denominations use to communicate through technology

cc_matches.description: Make strategic use of digital media (e.g., textual, graphical, audio, visual, and interactive elements) in presentations to enhance understanding of findings, reasoning, and evidence and to add interest.
